A self-centred yuppie lawyer is horrified when a judge finds him guilty of drink-driving and orders him to coach a hopeless inner-city junior ice-hockey team as part of his community service. However, he comes to appreciate his new role and things finally start to look up for the team. Comedy, starring Emilio Estevez, Joss Ackland, Lane Smith and Joshua Jackson.

Racing car Lightning McQueen heads overseas to compete in an international grand prix, with events in Britain, Japan and Italy. He gets mixed up in international espionage when a case of mistaken identity leads to an encounter with two English spy cars searching for a powerful gadget. Pixar animated adventure sequel, with the voices of Owen Wilson and Michael Caine.

As her pop starlet alter-ego Hannah Montana's fame begins to grow, teenager Miley Stewart gets carried away with the success and is sent to work on the family farm in Tennessee. With help from her faithful friends, she begins to discover who she really is and what is important in life. Family comedy, starring real-life father and daughter Miley and Billy Ray Cyrus, alongside Emily Osment, Jason Earles and Mitchel Musso.

A hard-working New Orleans waitress meets an arrogant prince who has been turned into a frog by a magic spell. When she tries to break the enchantment by kissing him, she also ends up transformed into an amphibian, and together they go in search of the voodoo queen who can change them back. Disney animated musical fantasy, with the voices of Anika Noni Rose and Bruno Campos.

Well-meaning ant Flick lands his colony in trouble when he accidentally disposes of an offering meant for a swarm of greedy grasshoppers - who promptly promise a horrible revenge. Faced with the imminent destruction of the anthill, he sets out to save the situation by enlisting the help of a few would-be heroes - an out-of-work troupe of bugs from a low-rent flea circus. Pixar animation, with the voices of Dave Foley, Kevin Spacey and Julia Louis-Dreyfus.

Six years after the events of Wreck-It Ralph, the destructive video game character and his hyperactive friend Vanellope discover a wi-fi router in Litwak's Family Fun Centre and Arcade. Before long, they embark on a new quest involving Disney princesses, and a few familar faces. Animated adventure, with the voices of John C Reilly, Sarah Silverman and Gal Gadot.

A clumsy security guard is critically injured during a run-in with a thief, so his cybernetics-expert employer transforms him into the ultimate crime-fighting machine - a bionic officer with an array of gadgets and weaponry cunningly concealed inside his body. Comedy adventure based on the 1980s cartoon series, starring Matthew Broderick, Rupert Everett and Joely Fisher.

After saving Xandar from Ronan's wrath, intergalactic outlaws Peter Quill (AKA Star-Lord), Gamora, Drax the Destroyer, Groot and Rocket Raccoon are recognised as heroes. Now, they must fight to stay together as they unravel the mystery surrounding Ego, a man who claims to be Quill's father. Writer/director James Gunn's follow up to his 2014 blockbuster, which reunites Chris Pratt, Zoe Saldana, Karen Gillan and Dave Bautista, with support from Kurt Russell, Sylvester Stallone and Pom Klementieff. Bradley Cooper also provides the voice of Rocket and Vin Diesel is Groot.

A crew of colonists sent to populate an alien planet have their mission diverted by a mysterious signal. After landing on a nearby world, they discover what became of the ill-fated Prometheus mission. Ridley Scott's sci-fi thriller, starring Katherine Waterston, Michael Fassbender and Danny McBride.

An old man tells a journalist the story of his youth as a lobby boy at a hotel in Eastern Europe in the 1930s. He was taken under the wing of the establishment's dashing concierge, and is drawn into his misadventures as he becomes involved in a conflict over a valuable painting. Wes Anderson's comedy drama, starring Ralph Fiennes, Tony Revolori, F Murray Abraham and Jude Law.

Fact-based drama about crime reporter Veronica Guerin, who set out to expose Ireland's crime lords but ended up paying the ultimate price. The film opens with the journalist's assassination, then looks back to trace her attempts to establish a link between Dublin's drug trade and infamous gangster Martin Cahill in the mid-1990s. Starring Cate Blanchett, Gerard McSorley, Ciaran Hinds and Brenda Fricker.

An orphan is forced to live a life of servitude by her cruel stepmother. The king of the realm she lives in organises a lavish ball to find a bride for his son, and a caring fairy godmother puts her magic to the task of turning the downtrodden girl into a princess. Animated fairytale, with the voices of Ilene Woods, William Phipps and Verna Felton.

The banquet is finally here. It's the culmination of months of hard work as the winning chefs strive to plate up perfect dishes for the ladies of the Women's Institute, at London's historic Draper's Hall where pioneers of the WI once gathered.

Three top chefs from Scotland are out to impress this week's veteran judge and be crowned Scottish champion. Adam Handling has already won a number of industry awards and is full of confidence. His starter sets out to take the diner on a tour of the UKs best producers. He's up against Michael Bremner, who is hoping to impress with contemporary ingredients including Birch sap and Douglas fir oil. Ally McGrath is celebrating his nation's finest produce and making his very own version of haggis.
Three newcomers to the competition create their fish dishes in a bid to be crowned Scottish champion. The standard is so high the veteran judge is moved to tears.

Ally McGrath has been keeping the veteran judge entertained with his very individual approach. Also, the highly competitive Adam Handling has been showcasing the finest produce grown and caught in and around the UK in his menu. Once again Michael Bremner is out to show how inventive he can be.

One chef will go home and today the veteran judge finds himself with a difficult decision to make. Inventive Chef Michael Bremner is recreating the Scottish deserts of his childhood, Adam Handling is sticking with his trademark Asian flavours and Ally McGrath is tempering chocolate for the very first time.

Scotland's two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges for the very first time. Both chefs have decided to make changes to some of their dishes, taking on board criticisms made during the week by the veteran judge.

Chef Josh Eggleton is back for a third time. Last year he made the national finals when his starter was shortlisted for the banquet, this year he intends to go one step further and cook at the banquet. One of his rivals last time, Jude Kereama is also back and out to do better than he did previously. The third competitor is newcomer Chris Wheeler who is originally from Swanage in Dorset.

There are some exciting dishes on the menu as the three chefs from the South West tackle the fish course. Chef Josh Eggleton is hoping to impress with an original take on Bolognese, just one of six elements on his complex fish dish.

It is the main course and Chef Chris Wheeler is out to show just how theatrical he can be, his ideas are surprising everyone in the kitchen. No one knows quite what to expect and the veteran chef is hoping it tastes as good as it looks.

It is the dessert course and it is Josh Eggleton who has come up with the most ambitious dessert. He is creating his own self-serve ice cream made from vegetables, he is making everything from scratch including toppings and syrups.

It is the head to head and the South West region's two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort. They are joined by guest judge, journalist and restaurant critic, Grace Dent.

Two newcomers to the competition are challenging reigning North West champion Matt Worswick. Adam Reid is Head Chef for one of the UK's leading culinary talents, and Kim Woodward who made history when she was appointed Head Chef at the Savoy Grill.

It is the fish course and reigning North West champion Matt Worswick has reason to be confident. However, Kim's confident she has got one up on Matt by baking her own black bread unlike Matt who's taking a shortcut.

It is the main course of the North West Regional heat and the scores mean this is a crucial round. Matt Worswick may be the reigning champion but he is not yet assured of a place cooking for the judges and he is feeling the strain.

It's the dessert course and the three North West competitors are getting creative, producing some of the most original and stunning desserts. All three chefs are working in a hot kitchen, the tension is palpable, and this time one chef will go home.

The cloak of war played a role in the genocide of WWII, allowing unfathomable horrors against innocent women, children, and men. Even within Allied nations, individuals were seen as a potential enemies and denied liberty.
Explores the aftermath of WWII in the wake of destruction and liberation, with tens of millions dead and millions more displaced.

p.t: Heinrich Müller - Head of the Gestapo
p.d: Heinrich Muller, WWI veteran and Freikorps member, rose to power and aligned with Adolf Hitler.

Germany is in decline. Once the world's most powerful country is now being devastated by WWII. Adolf Hitler has gone into hiding. The dreaded ruler is no longer openly supporting his people. He is slowly losing his mind.

Newsreel footage from the days of World War II, both on the home front and the battlefield. Pre-Pearl Harbor, the US helped democracies and men joined the army to prepare for WW2 and Japan's threat.

Newsreel footage from the days of World War II, both on the home front and the battlefield. In 1942 the US had victories in the Doolittle Raid, Coral Sea and Midway while the Nazi's were taking Europe.

Newsreel footage from the days of World War II, both on the home front and the battlefield. Take a look at WW2 in 1943, where the battle turned against North Africa and plans were laid to bomb Germany.
Newsreel footage from the days of World War II, both on the home front and the battlefield. In 1944, the US waged global war towards Rome and the Pacific, and 6 June marked the D-Day landings.
The Battle of the Bulge continued in 1945 and the US battled stiff resistance on Leyte and Iwo Jima.

p.t: Ramses: The Great King Of Ancient Egypt
p.d: After five years of reigning, Ramsses the Great had already earned the distinction of being the most feared and respected among the martial pharaohs. He personally led his army with the aim of reconquering the kingdoms of the Levant.
The team is in the north of Britain where they uncover evidence of the first Roman siege in Britain, Scottish man-made islands and a famous monastery.

Finds include the lost WWI training trenches on Salisbury Plain, Britain's first `double henge', discovered just down the road from Stonehenge, where the evidence suggests our ancestors feasted and made sacred offerings as part of a visit to the ritualistic Stonehenge landscape, and luxury foreign goods discovered at Tintagel, the legendary childhood home of King Arthur.
Volcanic Brown is the most credible link to gold in the upper pit. Dig into the prospector's story, why he went missing and what he may have found.
Clues revealed in Katzie First Nation history lead the team north; Kru unearths 100-year-old court documents that shed light on Slumach himself.
In York, Professor Alice Roberts takes part in a Viking battle, meets the metal detectorists behind one of the UK's greatest archaeological finds, and gets her hands on Viking poo.
Professor Alice Roberts tells the story of Roman Britain by studying the history of Chester, Britain's most Roman town.

Tony Robinson sets off on his most curious walk yet, across the ancient and turbulent kingdom of Northumbria. In the seventh century, at the height of the Dark Ages, the rule of Northumbria stretched from Edinburgh to York.
Tony Robinson travels along the wonderful seascapes of the North Norfolk coast and through one of the least developed spots in the country.

Alice Roberts follows the excavation of Iron Age Britain's most spectacular grave. A team of archaeologists in East Yorkshire have uncovered the remains of only the third upright chariot burial ever found in Britain.
Professor Alice Roberts explores 2019's most exciting archaeological finds.

p.t: Ramses: The Great King Of Ancient Egypt
p.d: Ramsses, known as 'Ramsses-great-in-victories', achieved divine status. His fame reached far beyond national borders. As pharaoh he acquired unprecedented power and prestige, making him considered a living god.

p.t: Ramses: The Great King Of Ancient Egypt
p.d: During his 77-year-old reign, King Ramses II worked to consolidate the borders of the Egyptian Empire, establish peace and build splendid temples. On his death, the future of the dual country was written by Merenptah, his successor and 13th son.
Despicable duo Raymond Fernandez and Martha Beck team up to con lonely women across the nation, posing as siblings to rob them of their riches.

A house with a bathroom layout challenge in Ripley, Derbyshire, a huge three-storey house with its freehold on offer in Erdington, Birmingham, and a mid-terrace house in London's East Ham in need of a major makeover are all sold under the hammer.

Dion Dublin is in Lincolnshire looking round a pair of rural semi-detached cottages which the new owner may convert into one home. Martin Roberts is in Cheshire at a bungalow with bags of potential, and Lucy Alexander is in Kent talking to friends embarking on their first project together.

A house in Chesterton in Staffordshire has a smelly problem and needs a total overhaul. The new owner of a semi in Bestwood in Nottingham also has a lot to do, while the new owner of a flat in Strawberry Hill has less than a week to sort out her auction buy before she jets off to Germany.

A husband and wife duo add their design skills to a house in Croydon in Surrey, while a seasoned developer creates a high-end house in multiple occupation in Coventry and a first time developer also does a great job with a house full of period features in Nutall in Nottinghamshire.

Martin Roberts meets one of two young brothers busy building a property portfolio in Bolsover, Derbyshire, while Dion Dublin checks out a three-bedroom semi in Wolverhampton, and Lucy Alexander is impressed by plans to convert a two-bedroom, fire-damaged terraced house in London's Plaistow into a smart five-bedroom property.

Dion Dublin has a hair-raising experience at a barber's in Rochdale, Lancashire, while Martin Roberts looks round a great bungalow in Alsager, Cheshire, and Lucy Alexander sees all the potential in a piece of land in Eccles in Kent.

Martin Roberts visits a house in Otterton, Devon, which is given a stunning transformation to match the views from the windows, Lucy Alexander looks round a small one-bedroom flat in Tottenham, London, and Dion Dublin peers into a building in Alvaston, Derby, which is in a dangerous state of disrepair.

Martin Roberts visits a house in Otterton, Devon, which is given a stunning transformation to match the views from the windows, Lucy Alexander looks round a small one-bedroom flat in Tottenham, London, and Dion Dublin peers into a building in Alvaston, Derby, which is in a dangerous state of disrepair.
Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin visit a one-bedroom flat in Catford, London, a large house near the River Mersey and a semi-detached property in Alvaston in Derby.

An end-terrace house in Alfreton in Derby bought by two brothers, a mid-terrace on the coast at Seaham in County Durham and a large three-storey property with a flat and shop in Taylorstown in the Rhondda Valley are all sold at auction. Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin talk to the new owners to find out what they have planned for their auction buys.

Martin Roberts falls in love with a quirky cottage in Malvern bought by a builder and his wife, Dion Dublin talks to a first-time property developer who sees her end-terrace house in Chell in Stoke-on-Trent as something for her pension pot, and Lucy Alexander meets a divorced couple who have decided to form a new union as property developers doing up a shop and flat in Dover, Kent.

A large piece of land in Ratby in Leicestershire, a terrace in Chesterton in Staffordshire and a 1930s semi with a huge garden and huge potential are all sold at auction. Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin meet the developers hoping to breathe new life into their auction buys.

A two-bedroom detached house in Basford in Nottingham, a top floor flat in Portsmouth and a large Edwardian terrace in Crewe are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners and hear about their plans.

A multimillion-pound development in Farningham in Kent, an ambitious, total renovation project in Aspatria in Cumbria and a very small studio flat in Wallington in Surrey are all sold under the hammer. Martin and Lucy meet the new owners to discuss their plans.

A Victorian terrace in London's Greenwich, two flats in Chatham in Kent and a riverside inn near Great Yarmouth in Norfolk are all sold under the hammer. Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin meet the new owners and hear plans for their renovation projects.

Discover the incredible hunting techniques that enable Valdez Bay's killer whales to dominate their environment, as they prepare to launch an assault on the region's elephant seals. 7+
Has a small island in the middle of the South Pacific become a drive-thru burger joint for the world's largest tiger sharks? Luring the giants to their boat, experts investigate. 7+
Summer of Sharks: Charleston, South Carolina is renowned for its hospitality. But in 2013, its resident sharks weren't quite as welcoming. 12+. (S9, ep 8)
Regeneration: Margot takes advantage of the milder Yukon weather and tries her hand at a few new wilderness DIY projects. 7+ (S1, ep 7)

They all had 1 massive song, then never skirted the UK Top 20 singles chart again! Here are 70 acts from every year of the 70s, in order, who all achieved their 15 minutes of fame.
Incredible facts and amazing trivia about some of the decade's most famous songs and videos! This is two hours of Radio 1 legend Bruno Brookes asking 'Can You Believe It?!'

p.t: Did They Really Do That? Top 30
p.d: Thirty fabulously great, but awful, chart hits and videos - all with that certain cringe factor attached. Did they really do that? They certainly did!
Forty-five minutes of back-to-back number 1s from 1972 - from The New Seekers to Little Jimmy Osmond via My Ding-a-Ling! With Mr Charts himself - Mark Goodier.
Classic hits from just 1 year - 1976!
Blimey, what a year! Get ready to turn your telly up LOUD, with the greatest party anthems from '72 including Bowie, Slade, The Sweet and The Osmonds. Don't forget your Ding-a-Ling!
Today we'd call it Cheesy Pop! Back then it was Bubblegum Pop & TISWAS Sally has a prime selection including David Cassidy, Mungo Jerry, Lynsey De Paul, Tony Orlando & The Osmonds.
Rewind to a time of big hair, outrageous makeup and platform shoes. The greatest gems of glam pop and rock, including Queen, ABBA and Wizzard.
Who were the biggest superstar showoffs of the decade? Well how about Sting, Meat Loaf, Iggy, Freddie, Geldof, Jagger, Rod and Daltrey for starters? But who's our No.1 rock frontman?
Non-stop 70s songs the cool kids were listening to in the latter half of the decade - expect skinny jeans, safety pins, guitars and just a few snarls!
From hippies to punk rockers, via folk, funk, soul & disco - these are the classic songs that made the 70s!
Classic hits from just 1 year - 1974!
Along with Abba, Elton John and Rod Stewart, Queen dominated the 70s, and like them continue to resonate today! The songs are magnificent, and the videos are quite good too.
We didn't yet call them Power Ballads, but some masters of the genre - Boston, Toto & Whitesnake - were already at it! Simes has twenty-five power pop love songs and ballads - in order.

p.t: Cuddle on the Couch - The Love 40
p.d: Three hours of 70s love. What more could you ask for a long smooch on the sofa?
Paul Young, who has sung one or two himself, brings you 25 classic '80s hits that were all covers, including Whitney, Madness, Billy Idol and Simply Red. Some will really surprise you!
Lesser known songs you may have forgotten from artists you'll certainly know!
Every one of these brilliant songs is a true '80s gem. Amazingly though, none of them ever made the UK Top 10. Great tunes from big names including Abba, INXS, Bon Jovi and more!
Robin Banks with 25 amazing songs, 25 nonsense titles - in order from 1980-1989. Fancy Dinner with Gershwin or a Walk with the Dinosaur? This is where to come!
You may remember the artists, but do you recall their lesser heard songs? With Tears Fears, Freddie Mercury & Level 42.
25 (mostly) great songs that all hit the top 3 in 1985, but didn't quite reach the summit. Including Marillion, Madonna, Alison Moyet, Prince, Jimmy Nail and Dee C Lee.
You may remember the artists, but do you recall their lesser heard songs? With Tears Fears, Freddie Mercury & Level 42.
60 minutes of back to back UK chart runners-up from 1985 - a year of Prince, King and Queen Madonna's big breakthrough! With Mr Charts himself, Mark Goodier.
Hits and headlines from the year of Live Aid, Back to the Future, Blind Date and the Sinclair C5!
10 artists that had a single big song in 1985 - then never darkened the UK Top 20 ever again! Remember Maria Vidal, Arcadia, John Parr and Phyllis Nelson?
You may remember the artists, but do you recall their lesser heard songs? With Tears Fears, Freddie Mercury & Level 42.
Month by month Bruno Brookes plays 12 lesser known hits of 1985! Including Billy Ocean and The Cure, plus forgotten acts like Strawberry Switchblade and The Colourfield.
You may remember the artists, but do you recall their lesser heard songs? With Tears Fears, Freddie Mercury & Level 42.
A choice selection of the 191 singles that reached the top of the UK charts in the 1980s!
Popcorn at the ready - it's a whole day of music from the movies!
275 songs reached number 1 across the 00s - a record - so there are bound to be a few you've long forgotten! Pat Sharp digs out 30, including David Sneddon, Meck and Orson.
Non-Stop No.1s - All Day! Every track a smash, every video a UK chart topping hit!
60 minutes of back-to-back number 1s from 2006 - from Leo Sayer who had Thunder in his Heart, to JT who brought Sexyback - Justin time! With Mr Charts himself - Mark Goodier.

p.t: It Was Number 1 For How Long?
p.d: Back in the 90s some songs hit the top spot and stayed there. In some cases for a very long time! Each of these acts were number 1 for at least 3 weeks, but who holds record?
Massive hitmakers who unbelievably only had a solitary UK number 1 - all of them in the 90s. Chesney Hawkes is in good company!
Non-Stop No.1s - All Day! Every track a smash, every video a UK chart topping hit!
Everyone is a Number 1! 40 of the biggest, most timeless love songs from the 90s & 00s! Featuring Westlife, Celine Dion, Leona Lewis, Robbie Williams, Bryan Adams & Whitney Houston!
Kick back and relax with some mellow moments. Chilled to perfection.
Girl Power! Boyband pin-ups, Britpop & High School Heroes! We're spending a whole day with the Smash Hits & Guilty Pleasures of the 1990s!
The One & Only year - bookended by The KLF, and featuring Cher, The Prodigy, Simply Red & Vic Reeves! Jenny Powell takes a Joyride through the pages of yet another NOW Yearbook.
A complete rundown of the 30 biggest-selling singles in the UK for 1992, including Michael Jackson, Billy Ray Cyrus & Freddie Mercury!
Girl Power! Boyband pin-ups, Britpop & High School Heroes! We're spending a whole day with the Smash Hits & Guilty Pleasures of the 1990s!
Mark Goodier with a definitive countdown of the 100 biggest acts of the 90s - compiled using record sales, concert tickets, awards & more - from the UK, the USA & around the world!
A little bit of love in the 90s from the likes of Take That, George Michael, Boyzone, Whitney Houston, Celine Dion and a load more.
Classic love & bittersweet 90s classics, all summed up in a single word title - As, Amazed, Pray, Crying, Lifted, Anything, Dreams, Wonderwall & more.
Laid back, timeless, soft rock tracks & big power ballads, each with an unforgettable chorus! Expect plenty of Fleetwood Mac, Foreigner, Pat Benatar, Spandau Ballet & Toto.
The Biggest Ballads from the royals of rock! From Queen, Bon Jovi & Whitesnake to Meat Loaf, Nickleback & Evanescence.
Let your hair down as Claire Sturgess has a wild ride of fabulous follicles and awesome rock hairdos! From Bowie's glamorous transformations to Joe Elliot's indestructible mullet.
Live it loud and Max out on the finest rock anthems! Featuring The Arctic Monkeys, Nickleback, Green Day & The Strokes. This is Now Rock!

p.t: Turn Up The Pop Punk Anthems!
p.d: Turn up your speakers to 11 and live life even louder! 1 hour of 00s Pop Punk Anthems in order, featuring Green Day, Blink-182, Sum 41, Bowling For Soup and The All-American Rejects.
25 All-Killer 00s Dumbass Anthems! From Blink-182 and Wheatus to Fall Out Boy and Scouting For Girls.
A decade of mega hits and the loudest anthems! Expect Biffy Clyro, Linkin Park, Blink 182, Evanescence, Fall Out Boy & loads more!

p.d: From Motorhead to AC/DC, Guns N Roses to Aerosmith, we start at 1970 and bring you the best guitar riffs through the years that you are desperate to learn!

Party pop rock anthems spanning 5 decades! From Queen, Kiss & Aerosmith to Blur, Paramore & The White Stripes.
A mega-blast of the loudest, fastest, most anthemic assault of rock tracks! With Motley Crue, Pearl Jam, Royal Blood, Nirvana, Ozzy & loads more!
Party pop rock anthems spanning 5 decades! From Queen, Kiss & Aerosmith to Blur, Paramore & The White Stripes.

Crammed full with extraordinary finds, hidden treasures, and plenty of old relics! From the Stones and Genesis, to Iggy and Aerosmith - how many of these family heirlooms do you own?
Turn it up to 11 for the finest rock anthems! Featuring Kings Of Leon, The Killers, Green Day, Biffy Clyro & The Foo Fighters. This is Now Rock!

p.d: Delving deep into the lives of Brian Thompson and Luigi Mangione, exploring their contrasting backgrounds, the events that drew them into each others orbit, and the shocking manifesto Mangione released that sent the internet into chaos.
Carmine Galante took the Mob into the world of heroin and even when locked up in jail, Galente still managed to control the streets and profit from his drug empire.
Financier Allen Dorfman used union pension funds to bankroll the Mafia and the FBI quickly realised they could bankrupt the Mob by pursuing Dorfman.
Joe Valachi was the first Mafia member to break the Mob's code of silence and turn public informer, revealing the term `Cosa Nostra' to the world.
Professional rodeo rider, Randy Flynn, is gunned down and investigators confront whispered accusations about who pulled the trigger; rumours fly about a philandering pastor.
When young mother Lillian Jarvis is killed by a mail bomb, gossip explodes in the community as secrets about her past come to light.
A Silicon Valley executive goes missing, then turns up stuffed in a sleeping bag at the bottom of the San Francisco Bay.

Following a team of experts as they investigate whether evidence exists that could challenge the conviction of a man in prison for a murder he denies. Every year, over 500 people in the UK are convicted of murder. A guilty verdict can only be challenged if new evidence comes to light. Inside Justice is a specialist charity led by Louise Shorter, supported by a panel of criminal lawyers, ex-police officers and forensics experts who offer assistance to prisoners who are protesting their innocence.

Louise investigates a case, looking for evidence that could present grounds to bring an appeal, and ultimately overturn the conviction of a Southampton man in prison for the murder of his secret lover.
Inside Justice investigate the conviction of Glyn Razzell, found guilty of his wife's murder. Glyn maintains his innocence, and now there's an alleged link with a double murderer.

Every three days, a woman is killed in the UK. These women could be sisters, daughters and friends. Although there is a lead that breaks open the case, what comes in light of the investigation is one that leaves an everlasting scar on the families.

The Manson Family, led by Charles Manson, committed a set of crimes that terrified the world and brought the flower power movement to a halt. Charles Milles Manson was an American criminal and musician who led the Manson Family, a cult based in California.
Gambino family soldier Roy DeMeo and his crew were suspected of killing dozens of people and dismembering their bodies, but the FBI and other mobsters were soon on his trail.
A million years ago, Italy was a battlefield where enormous, violent volcanoes raised mountains and erased valleys.

This film follows two brothers, heirs to the throne, who were separated because of the murder of their parents. One grows up and vows to avenge their death, while the other is oblivious.
